description: Source code for the ImageFunctionHLSL class, which generates HLSL code for ESSL image functions, including functions for size, load, and store operations on various image types.

classes.name: ImageFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for generating HLSL implementations of ESSL image functions.

classes.name: ImageFunctionHLSL::ImageFunction
classes.description: Struct representing an image function with properties like image type, format, method, and read-only status.

methods.name: GetImageReference
methods.description: Generates a string reference for an image based on its properties, outputting code to the sink.

methods.name: OutputImageFunctionArgumentList
methods.description: Outputs the argument list for an image function based on its type and method.

methods.name: OutputImageSizeFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the size query function for an image.

methods.name: OutputImageLoadFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the load function for an image.

methods.name: OutputImageStoreFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the store function for an image.

methods.name: useImageFunction
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an image function based on name, type, format, and read-only flag, and registers it for code generation.

methods.name: imageFunctionHeader
methods.description: Generates the header and implementation of all registered image functions.
